text: Two of the most useful standard modules are math for calculations and random for chance.
math gives you constants like pi and e, ready to use with full precision.
It also has the functions you'd expect — square roots, factorials, floor and ceiling rounding.
[chuckle] There are gems tucked in too, like gcd, the greatest common divisor of two numbers.
[sniff] random generates unpredictable values — but seed it, and the sequence becomes perfectly repeatable.
That's vital for testing, since you get the same random numbers every run.
randint rolls a die, choice picks one item, and sample draws several unique ones, like a lottery.
[sigh] shuffle rearranges a list in place, perfect for dealing cards or randomizing an order.
[groan] Between math and random, a huge range of numeric and probabilistic tasks are already solved for you.
